SELECT f.* FROM sensor_ingest_file f LEFT JOIN phm_device d ON d.id = f.device_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND f.id = #{id} AND f.status = #{status} AND f.source_type = #{sourceType} AND (f.device_code = #{deviceCode} OR f.device_id IS NULL) AND (f.point_id = #{pointId} OR f.point_id IS NULL) AND f.attachment_id = #{attachmentId}
AND (f.file_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR f.device_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR f.point_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND 1 = 1
AND (f.device_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_device ud WHERE ud.user_id = #{scopeUserId} AND ud.device_id = f.device_id ))
ORDER BY f.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE sensor_ingest_file SET device_id=#{deviceId},device_code=#{deviceCode},point_id=#{pointId}, point_code=#{pointCode},channel_id=#{channelNo},status='VALIDATING', error_code=NULL,error_message=NULL,update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('UNMAPPED','REJECTED')
UPDATE sensor_ingest_file SET status='RECEIVING',retry_count=retry_count+1,error_code=NULL, error_message=NULL,update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='FAILED'
